name: Southern Star Line DT and DS Replacement Project

values.SegmentName: Line DT and DS Replacement Project
values.Owner: Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc

researcher_notes: Not a match to P4461 (that row is a Northern Natural Gas line in South Dakota and Iowa). No existing row covers this project. Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline has rows P0253 (system), P2564 and P7826, none of them this project. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission environmental assessment for docket CP19-31 says Southern Star would build 31.5 miles of new 36-inch pipe, called Line DPA, plus about 5.9 miles of small laterals. It replaces Line DS (31.4 miles, 20 inch) and Line DT (31.8 miles, 26 inch) in Anderson and Franklin counties, Kansas. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 1010, lists the project as completed 23 November 2020, 31.5 miles, 36 inches, cost 99.1 million dollars, pipeline type intrastate. EIA and the FERC document are separate origins. The Federal Register notice from 13 September 2019 confirms the docket and sponsor. Passes the length rule: 31.5 miles is about 50.7 km of new pipe, though it replaces old pipe. No capacity stated, left blank. Owner matches the existing entity Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc. No start or end town found, so only the state is filled. No official route file was found, so route is none. Possible follow-up: the exact FERC docket CP19-31 route maps could give a route.
